name: Mario + Rabbids® Sparks of Hope

needs.what: Snowdrop's page pools are not resized: the engine reserves 12 GB of address space, which a 4 GB memory cannot give.

cuts.why: Unused 272-byte slot pool: 4,194,304 -> 65,536 slots, 1.06 GB -> 17 MB of address space (mov w1,#0x10000)

address_space.note: the profile reserves heap 0.13 GB, alias 4.38 GB, stack 0.25 GB with a pool of 3.21 GB; this process has heap 0.13 GB, alias 3.44 GB, stack 0.06 GB: everything the pool lets the game commit fits, with less spare address space than nxnative gives it
